labelDefinition.normal: 0 = no continuous/coupled fault in 64-point window and no transient univariate event in last 8 points
labelDefinition.abnormal: 1 = continuous/coupled fault active in >=50% of the 64-point window OR transient event in last 8 points
labelDefinition.transition: -1 = continuous/coupled fault active in >0 and <50% of the 64-point window; excluded from MSF training

splitRule: scenario-level split; no window from one scenario crosses train/val/test
benchmarkBoundary: synthetic coupling benchmark; relation groups are controlled engineering-inspired abstractions, not flight-validated equations
